title: Hamleys Black Friday 2026: dates, best toy deals and what to buy now
description: When Hamleys Black Friday 2026 starts, the toy deals already live (half price on many Hamleys toys) and what to buy now versus wait for.
intro:
**Hamleys hasn't announced its Black Friday 2026 dates yet, but it already has a big sale running: lots of its own-brand toys are half price, and selected Playmobil is 25% off.** The best picks right now are the Glow Flip Super Track Racer at £19 (was £38) and the Foldable Light Up Scooter at £45 (was £90).

Black Friday itself is on Friday 27 November. We'll update this page as soon as Hamleys confirms its plans. Prices were checked on 9 November 2026.

deals.name: Hamleys Glow Flip Super Track Racer (91 pieces)
deals.note: A glow-in-the-dark flexible track with a car that flips, for ages around 3 and up. A solid stocking-to-main-present gift for £19.

deals.name: Hamleys Foldable Light Up Scooter
deals.note: A folding kick scooter with light-up wheels. Half price makes it a reasonable big present, but compare it with branded scooters before you buy.

deals.name: Hamleys Four-Wheel Drive Remote Controlled Big Wheel Stunt Car with Spray
deals.note: A chunky remote-control stunt car with a mist-spray effect. £25 is a fair price for a remote-control car that kids actually play with.

deals.name: Hamleys Daredevil Stunt Remote Control Car
deals.note: A bigger, faster remote-control stunt car for older kids. Half price brings it under £50.

deals.name: Hamleys Arthur Bear
deals.note: A soft Hamleys teddy at half price. A classic first-Christmas or new-baby present.

deals.name: LEGO Creator London Bus 40220
deals.note: A small Lego build of a red London bus, sold only at selected retailers. An easy stocking filler for under £16.

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: Full price at Hamleys. Lego advent calendars sell out before December, so don't leave it too late. Compare prices in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

deals.name: Toniebox 2 Starter Set with Creative Tonie
deals.note: The new Toniebox 2 audio player for young children, at full price. It's one of Hamleys' trending toys, but there's no discount yet, so keep an eye on it in Black Friday week.

body:
## When is Hamleys Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday is on **Friday 27 November 2026**, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. As of 9 November, Hamleys hasn't published dates for a Black Friday event. That doesn't matter much this year, because it's already discounting a lot of its range. We'll update this page when Hamleys confirms its plans.

For every retailer's dates, see [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) and our [Black Friday 2026 hub](/black-friday/).

## What's on offer at Hamleys right now

- **Half price on many Hamleys own-brand toys:** remote-control cars, plush, the Glow Flip track racer, scooters, dolls and games. Some smaller items are 70% off, such as the Go Froggy Go game at £6.60.
- **25% off selected Playmobil:** including police, fire rescue and camping sets.
- **Exclusives:** a few sets are only sold at selected retailers, such as the Lego Creator London Bus.

One word of caution: Hamleys own-brand toys are only sold at Hamleys, so there's no other shop to compare the 'was' prices against. We'd judge them on the price you pay now, not the size of the discount. All the deals above are fair prices for what you get.

## Should you buy now or wait for Black Friday?

- **Hamleys own-brand toys:** buy now if you like them. They're already half price, and it's hard to see them going much lower.
- **Big brands (Lego, Tonies, Playmobil):** these are sold everywhere, so check Amazon and Argos as well. Hamleys often charges the full price on Lego, while other shops discount it. Our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) shows where each set is cheapest.
- **Popular Christmas toys:** don't wait too long. The year's must-have toys tend to sell out in early December, whatever the discount.

## More gift ideas

Shopping on a budget? Try our [Christmas gifts for kids under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-kids-under-20/). For curious kids, see our [STEM gifts guide](/guides/stem-gifts-for-kids/), and browse everything on our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) page.

## FAQs

### Does Hamleys do Black Friday?

Yes. Hamleys usually runs Black Friday offers on selected toys. In 2026 it already has half-price deals on many of its own-brand toys, weeks before Black Friday.

### Is Hamleys more expensive than other toy shops?

It can be on big brands like Lego, which Hamleys often sells at the full price. Its own-brand toys, which you can't buy anywhere else, are often heavily discounted. Compare branded toys with Amazon and Argos before you buy.

### When should I buy Christmas toys?

Buy the year's most popular toys by late November, because they're the first to sell out. Smaller gifts and stocking fillers can wait for Black Friday week.

### Does Hamleys deliver in time for Christmas?

Hamleys publishes its Christmas delivery cut-off dates on its website in December. Check them before you order, and allow extra time in the last week before Christmas.
